name: Roth.normOne_le_card_mul
source:
theorem normOne_le_card_mul (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) {B : ℝ} (hB : ∀ d, |((P.coeff d : ℤ) : ℝ)| ≤ B) :
    normOne P ≤ P.support.card * B := by
  simpa [normOne] using P.support.sum_le_card_nsmul _ _ (fun d _ ↦ hB d)
